thread:
infra-bot: INCIDENT P1: Rapid GPU queue growth and autoscaler errors in prod-gpu-cluster. Observed sustained queue > 12k requests, scheduler unable to place pods, fragmentation alarm triggered.
anya: seeing huge queue, all GPUs at 100% allocated but lots of small free fragments. requests are piling, some jobs TTLing.
devon: logs show autoscaler failed to create nodes: `quotaExceeded` on gcloud side and also `insufficientMIGSlices` error from scheduler. excerpt:
```
  scaler: failed to scale up: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = quotaExceeded
  scheduler: placement failed: best-fit returns no node: available fragments: [0.25g,0.5g,0.5g,0.25g], request: 1g
```
mike: confirmed impact on embeddings and long running reranks. latency up 6-8x, some requests 503'ed due to token throttling.
sophia: tagging customer impact: 4 customers in premium tier reported slow embeddings; CS pinged. @eve-cs are you on it?
eve-cs: notified customers, sent preliminary note — "degraded embeddings latency; mitigation in progress. we'll update in 30m" :warning:
jordan: looks like MIG sizing is the issue — we have mixed sizes (1g, 2g slices) and binpacking isn't consolidating small free slices. leads to stranded capacity.
oncall-sre: I'm taking this. priority: free up GPU real capacity or failover to dedicated-hosted routing. plan: 1) attempt manual consolidation of MIG slices 2) force-batch fallback to smaller model variant 3) open emergency quota request if needed.
devon: running `kubectl get pods -o wide --selector=workload=embeddings` shows a lot of small jobs pinned to large nodes. plan to cordon a few nodes and drain to relocate smaller pods onto better-fit nodes.
anya: before cordon/drain — put routing rule to divert new heavy embedding requests to fallback model (quantized) to reduce pressure. issuing change now.
infra-bot: ROUTING CHANGE: embeddings-heavy route -> model:embed-lite-quantized (auto) applied by automation.
mike: applied temporary token throttling (per-customer cap) to reduce queue while we remediate.
sophia: note: autoscaler errors include `placementFragmentation` in metrics. thresholds crossed at 2023-11-08T18:12:03Z. (alert history attached).
jordan: manual MIG consolidation step: stop small-slice instances and recreate as 1g slices where possible. This will require node drains and short job restarts. expecting ~2-3 minute disruption per node.
oncall-sre: starting consolidation on node pool `gpu-pool-a` now. will proceed 1 node at a time. follow commands: ```
  gcloud compute instances stop $NODE && gcloud compute instances update-container --gpu-mig-slice=1g && gcloud compute instances start $NODE
```
devon: autoscaler fix: PR #4897 to improve packing heuristic and prefer consolidation was submitted. we can hotfix but need manual steps to buy time.
anya: manual reclaim in progress: reclaimed 3.0 GPU equivalent by consolidating two nodes — queue dropping from 12k -> 3.2k. latency improving.
eve-cs: updated customers: "we've implemented routing fallback and are applying backend consolidation; embeddings latency should improve over next 10-20 minutes".
mike: still seeing spikes in throttling at peaks; some retry storms from clients making queue bounce. recommend increasing client-side backoff guidance.
sophia: impact summary for postmortem: root cause = MIG fragmentation + suboptimal binpacking + autoscaler didn't detect fragmented capacity as reclaimable; contributing = quota error preventing fast scale up.
oncall-sre: mitigation checklist completed: routing fallback applied, 3 GPUs reclaimed via consolidation, manual drains executed, per-customer caps enabled. queue now stable ~800-1k and trending down.
jordan: follow-ups: (1) change default MIG sizing to reduce micro-slices for high-churn workloads, (2) autoscaler: add fragmentation-aware scaler loop to consider consolidating before scaling out, (3) add a preemptive emergency quota runbook.
devon: submitting incident PR with metrics + logs + `kubectl` steps and exact nodes touched. will include `gcloud` requests and quota ticket id.
eve-cs: customers acknowledged update and will keep monitoring.
infra-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity reduced to P2. next update in 1h or when status changes.
oncall-sre: handing off to second shift @mike for monitoring. I'll be available via DM.
mike: ack, monitoring dashboard pinned, will escalate if queue rises above 2k or any 503s resume.
anya: big TODOs for postmortem: timeline, exact allocator logs, PR for packing heuristic, tests to simulate fragmentation. tagging @devon @jordan for code changes.
sophia: logging note: add a new metric `fragmentation_free_gpus` and alert when > 70% fragmentation for > 5m.
infra-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (workaround applied). final state: autoscaler PR queued, manual consolidation completed, customer impact contained. follow-up: postmortem scheduled tomorrow 09:30 PT.
